description: Add something only the Developer can try by hand to a claimed Goal, such as 'OpenCode may ask permission to read an attached file: allow it and check the reply'. Put it here instead of in your chat summary: the Developer sees the Goal's hand-test list on the dashboard and marks each one there as works, doesn't work (with a note) or won't test. A failure adds a Task to the Goal by itself; get_status shows what is still open and the new marks. A Goal cannot be completed while a hand test is unmarked.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about, such as 't3'.

text.description: What to try and what to look for, in one or two short plain sentences.

name: add_hand_test
title: Add hand test
